class.rites_and_paths.spin_master.name: Spin Master
subclass.rites_and_paths.spin_rider.name: Rider
ability.rites_and_paths.sphere_throw.des: With the bandolier in hand: left click, the ball is guided toward where you aim (it reaches farther but is a bit slower); right click, it curves toward where you look, and holding it charges the throw: fully charged, it reaches twice as far, stays stuck twice as long and deals ×1.5 damage. The ball drills into the target and spins on it for 1 second, damaging it with several ticks (ignoring its invulnerability); each tick loses against armor the same as the whole impact would in a single hit. Every bounce, off a block or after spinning in an enemy, sends it toward where your camera looks: you aim at the next enemy yourself. With no bounces left, it comes back to your hand. Clicking right as it arrives is a Perfect Catch: more Spin and you throw it again instantly. Every block it bounces off before hitting adds damage.
ability.rites_and_paths.spin_bar.name: Spin
ability.rites_and_paths.spin_bar.desc: A 0-100% bar that fills with every hit, more if you chain them. If a ball comes back without hitting any enemy, you lose half of it; out of combat it slowly drains. At 33%: one more bounce and golden trails. At 66%: a stronger material effect and a bit more damage. At 100%: you can use the Golden Rectangle (from Total Level 30).
ability.rites_and_paths.bounce_route.des: Billiard shot: your ball shoots toward the enemy you aim at and jumps from enemy to enemy, hitting each one in passing (every hit strikes harder than the last), until it drills into the last one. With a single enemy, it bounces around it and comes back for it. Every hit raises your Spin.
ability.rites_and_paths.reverse_spin.des: Pulls on your embedded ball (or on the last enemy you hit a moment ago) and drags it towards you. Bosses do not move. Detonates your mines.
ability.rites_and_paths.spin_step.name: Spin Step
ability.rites_and_paths.spin_step.desc: A spiral dash of about 6 blocks towards where you move (or where you look if you stand still). Your next hit shortly after gives more Spin.
ability.rites_and_paths.golden_rectangle: With Spin at 100%, an automatic sequence with a cinematic camera: time stops around you, you scan the enemy you aim at and throw a golden ball that holds it in an infinite rotation, damaging it nonstop; even if it tries to escape, the rotation drags it back. A last critical blow slams it into the ground and the rotation jumps to nearby enemies. While it lasts you cannot move, but you take no damage.
ability.rites_and_paths.shared_weak_poin: Your allies also see the Weak Point marks, and every hit renews them.
class.rites_and_paths.spin_master.desc: Throws balls of different materials that drill in spinning, bounce and come back to the hand: left click, guided toward where you aim; right click, curved and chargeable; the bandolier holds the balls and a key switches the one you use. Hybrid skirmisher: hits up close and from afar and rewards rhythm, combos and precision. Every chained hit raises their Spin, which empowers the balls and charges the Golden Rectangle.
branch.rites_and_paths.spin_master.rotat: Your balls deal more damage ticks while they spin stuck in the target (more damage on single hits) and your Spin rises faster.
branch.rites_and_paths.spin_master.rebou: More bounces, and balls that bounce from one enemy to another keep more damage.
branch.rites_and_paths.spin_master.spher: Your balls are ready sooner after coming back and, with the full branch, you can have one more in flight.
More critical chance and damage; your critical hits with balls ignore part of the armor.
branch.rites_and_paths.spin_master.curve: The curved throw (right click) curves more and your balls fly farther.
perk.rites_and_paths.spin_master.rotatio: Your balls deal more damage while they spin stuck in the target, but Spin rises a bit slower.
Spin rises much faster, but your balls deal a bit less damage.
perk.rites_and_paths.spin_master.rebound: One more bounce, but every chained bounce deals less damage than the one before.
Your balls no longer bounce off blocks, but they jump to two more enemies.
perk.rites_and_paths.spin_master.sphere_: One more ball in flight at once, but they take longer to be ready after coming back.
If they hit, your balls return to your hand instantly, but you have one ball fewer in flight (at least one).
perk.rites_and_paths.spin_master.scan.co: The first hit on each target is a guaranteed critical (once in a while per target), but your general critical chance drops.
perk.rites_and_paths.spin_master.scan.st: Every consecutive hit on the same target deals more damage; it resets when you switch targets.
perk.rites_and_paths.spin_master.curve.t: The curved throw curves twice as much, but your balls fly less far.
perk.rites_and_paths.spin_master.curve.g: While a ball is flying, a right click instantly redirects it once towards where you look (instead of charging another one). Your balls are a bit slower.
class.rites_and_paths.spin_master.trait: Class trait: a bit less maximum health.
subclass.rites_and_paths.spin_rider.desc: Spins at full speed: if your balls hit while you run (or ride) close to your top speed, they stun the target and deal a bit more damage.
subclass.rites_and_paths.spin_scanner.de: Reads weak points: the first ball that hits a target marks it, and the following ones are guaranteed criticals. From level 5, your allies see the mark and every hit renews it.
subclass.rites_and_paths.spin_trapper.de: Plants their balls as mines: while sneaking, the ball sticks into the ground or a wall and explodes when an enemy walks by, slowing it down.

tooltip.rites_and_paths.sphere.effect.di: Ignores part of the target's armor.
tooltip.rites_and_paths.sphere.effect.ne: Burns and knocks back hard. Resists fire and lava.
tooltip.rites_and_paths.sphere.effect.sl: Slime: Bounces much more and barely loses speed.
tooltip.rites_and_paths.sphere.effect.co: Copper: Jumps to nearby enemies. During thunderstorms, it attracts lightning.
tooltip.rites_and_paths.sphere.effect.am: Amethyst: Releases a sonic wave in a line that goes through blocks and blinds.
tooltip.rites_and_paths.sphere.effect.en: Ender Pearl: When it returns, it takes you to the point of impact.
tooltip.rites_and_paths.sphere.effect.go: Gold: Very fast and ready sooner.
tooltip.rites_and_paths.sphere.effect.re: Redstone: Activates the redstone it hits.
tooltip.rites_and_paths.sphere.effect.dr: Dripstone: Breaks soft blocks and brings them back to you.
enchantment.rites_and_paths.friction.des: Your balls set fire to enemies and to the flammable blocks they hit.
enchantment.rites_and_paths.magnet.desc: Your balls are ready sooner after coming back, but deal a bit less damage.
enchantment.rites_and_paths.claw.desc: The ball stays embedded longer and Reverse Spin pulls harder, but it flies a bit slower.
enchantment.rites_and_paths.elasticity.d: More bounces, but every bounce deals a bit less damage.

tooltip.rites_and_paths.sphere.upgrade_h: Upgrade it at a crafting table with a few units of a material (for example, 4 copper ingots).
tooltip.rites_and_paths.sphere.effect.fl: Drill (flint): less damage per tick, but it stays stuck much longer and deals more damage in total.
tooltip.rites_and_paths.sphere.effect.ob: Crusher (obsidian): all the damage in a single hit, without staying stuck; it is slower and takes longer to be ready again.
effect.rites_and_paths.angelic_form.desc: Angel (Cleric): while it lasts you can fly, slowly and without sprinting.
effect.rites_and_paths.arcane_step.descr: Mage (Fluidity): +30% movement speed after casting a spell.
effect.rites_and_paths.banner.descriptio: You are inside a Paladin's Banner aura: more armor and shorter negative effects; depending on the banner, also more damage or regeneration for allies.
effect.rites_and_paths.berserker_rage.de: Berserker Rage (Barbarian): you attack faster and deal more damage, but you also take more.
effect.rites_and_paths.bulwark.descripti: Bulwark (Paladin): you take much less damage from every source.
effect.rites_and_paths.challenge.descrip: Potion of Challenge: zone difficulty counts 20% more class level per effect level, so mobs that spawn nearby are stronger. Milk removes it.
Charging Bulwark (Paladin): you run nonstop at high speed, damaging and pushing whoever you run over and breaking weak blocks in your way.
effect.rites_and_paths.charmed.descripti: Charmed (Bard): it does not attack the Bard or their allies and fights other mobs.
effect.rites_and_paths.condemned.descrip: Condemned (Paladin): takes more damage from the Paladin who marked it.
effect.rites_and_paths.corrosion.descrip: Corrosion (Acid Draconid): −5% armor and armor toughness per level.
effect.rites_and_paths.downed.descriptio: Downed (Cleric's Miracle): a lethal hit left you on the ground with half a heart. You cannot do anything, but you take no damage; if an ally heals you with a spell or a Cleric ability, you get up. If it runs out, you die.
effect.rites_and_paths.forced_dance.desc: Forced Dance (Bard): it dances in place and cannot attack, cast spells or use items.
effect.rites_and_paths.gigantism.descrip: Gigantism (elite mobs): the creature is bigger; the effect level shows its size.
effect.rites_and_paths.golden_spin.descr: Golden Spin (Spin Master): you are in the middle of the Golden Rectangle. You cannot move or act, but you take no damage.
effect.rites_and_paths.hunters_mark.desc: Hunter's Mark (Ranger): the marked target takes more damage from every source.
effect.rites_and_paths.immortal_fury.des: Last Fury (Barbarian): a lethal hit made you immortal for a few seconds. If you kill your attacker before it ends, you survive.
effect.rites_and_paths.iron_chorale.desc: Iron Chorale (Bard): you take less damage.
effect.rites_and_paths.mana_cadence.desc: Mana Cadence (Bard): you regenerate mana faster (1% per level).
effect.rites_and_paths.march.description: March (Bard): you move and attack faster.
effect.rites_and_paths.plague.descriptio: Plague (Barbarian): damage over time that affects even the undead. Milk removes it.
effect.rites_and_paths.requiem_fervor.de: Requiem Fervor (Bard): you deal more damage for a few seconds after the Final Requiem.
effect.rites_and_paths.rest_ballad.descr: Ballad of Rest (Bard): you regenerate health every second.
effect.rites_and_paths.scale_ward_fire.d: Scales against Fire (Bard): you take 25% less fire damage.
effect.rites_and_paths.scale_ward_ice.de: Scales against Ice (Bard): you take 25% less ice damage.
effect.rites_and_paths.scale_ward_lightn: Scales against Lightning (Bard): you take 25% less lightning damage.
effect.rites_and_paths.taunt_guard.descr: Taunt: you take less damage while the taunted mobs come after you.
effect.rites_and_paths.toxin.description: Toxin (Rogue): slow damage over time that does not stack. Milk removes it.
effect.rites_and_paths.tranquility.descr: Potion of Tranquility: zone difficulty counts 20% less class level per effect level, so mobs that spawn nearby are weaker. Milk removes it.
effect.rites_and_paths.war_hymn.descript: War Hymn (Bard): you deal more damage.
jei.rites_and_paths.info.sphere: Spin Master ball: thrown from the Sphere Bandolier. At a crafting table, combine it with 4 units of a material (2 ender pearls) to give it an upgrade: slime, copper, amethyst, ender pearl, gold, redstone, dripstone, flint (Drill) or obsidian (Crusher). A new upgrade replaces the previous one and the ball keeps its durability and enchantments.
jei.rites_and_paths.info.sphere_bandolie: Holds up to 9 balls: right click with a ball on the cursor to put it in, right click on an empty slot to take one out. The Spin Master holds it to throw the balls; the switch-ball key chooses which.
jei.rites_and_paths.info.sheet_music: Bard sheet music. Made at Iron's scroll forge with a music spell (like a scroll, with a music disc, a note block or a jukebox as focus). It is stored in an instrument at the music stand or the inscription table, and goes up one level at a crafting table with the ink rarity it asks for.
jei.rites_and_paths.info.eternal_sun_lut: Legendary Bard instrument: dropped by Barako and Umvuthi (Mowzie's Mobs) when killed by a player.
jei.rites_and_paths.info.abyssal_reed: Dropped by the Leviathan (L_Ender's Cataclysm) when killed by a player. Used to make the Abyssal Organ at a smithing table.
jei.rites_and_paths.info.colossus_drumsk: Dropped by the Netherite Monstrosity (L_Ender's Cataclysm) when killed by a player. Used to make the Colossus Drum at a smithing table.
jei.rites_and_paths.info.creative_amulet: Creative only, for testing: while it is in your inventory, every class and race cooldown is 0.
